warnings.over_limit_magnet: **You can only list {limit} magnet schools.** {names} would not count.
warnings.would_not_accept: You said you might not accept {names}. **Only list schools you would accept.**

checklist.student_id: {child}'s student ID number (ask the school if you don't have it)
checklist.address_on_file: Your address, matching what the school has on file

steps.sign_in_or_register: Sign in with your Parent Portal account, or tap "Register" to create one and confirm your email.
steps.rank_magnet_choices: Put your schools in order: the one you want most first (3 at most).
steps.add_dle_choice: If you want, also add the dual-language program (a separate program type).
steps.list_siblings: If you have other children in the program, add them as siblings.
steps.check_address: Check that your address matches what the school has.
steps.submit_and_save_confirmation: Submit and save the confirmation (a screenshot).
